brief: Patience compounds. Hype dies. A meditation on the long game for indie founders in the AI gold rush.

slots.headline: Patience Compounds While Hype Fades in the AI Gold Rush

slots.title: Hype Is Loud
slots.body: AI headlines scream overnight success, but most fortunes are built in silence. The tools change; the timeline rarely does. Chasing noise distracts from the work that actually compounds.

slots.title: Speed Masks Risk
slots.body: Shipping fast is celebrated, but sustainable products require deep understanding. Velocity without direction burns runway and energy. True progress often looks boring from the outside.

slots.title: Compounding Trust
slots.body: Every small promise kept builds equity that no ad budget can buy. In a market flooded with launches, reliability becomes your moat. Reputation is the original network effect.

slots.title: Ignore the Gold Rush
slots.body: Miners rarely strike it rich; the shovel sellers do. Building infrastructure and relationships outlasts any single model cycle. Play the long game instead of the lottery.

slots.title: Boring Is Durable
slots.body: Flashy features attract copycats. Boring fundamentals retain users. When the hype cycle crashes, only useful products survive. Build what people will still need next year.

slots.title: Stay in the Arena
slots.body: The founders who win are simply those who remain. Consistency beats intensity when the timeline is decades. Keep building when nobody is clapping yet.

slots.headline: Patience Is Your Unfair Advantage
slots.body: Join a newsletter for indie founders who choose substance over speed. No hype, just weekly perspective on building what lasts.
